//: paramux agent-attention hooks for Claude Code. Merge the `hooks` block
//1: into your Claude Code settings.json (~/.claude/settings.json for all
//2: projects, or .claude/settings.json in a project). Requires winghostty
//3: on PATH; otherwise replace `winghostty` with the full path to
//4: winghostty.com. Each hook runs inside the pane, so +notify writes to
//5: that pane's console and lights exactly that pane. Lifecycle mapping:
//6: prompt submitted -> working (blue), needs input -> waiting (amber),

hooks.command: winghostty +notify --state=waiting Claude Code needs your input
